title: RESEARCH: wc_RsaSSL_Verify API — does it write to caller buffer or use internal?
description: soft_verify() passes a 512-byte stack buffer to wc_RsaSSL_Verify(). Need to check wolfCrypt source/docs: does wc_RsaSSL_Verify() write the decrypted signature to the output pointer, or does it use an internal buffer and return a pointer into it? If it writes to caller's buffer, a 4096-bit key (512-byte modulus) exactly fills the buffer — no overflow for RSA-4096 but any larger key would overflow. Check wolfCrypt's wc_RsaSSL_Verify signature and behavior in ~/wolfssl/wolfcrypt/src/rsa.c. Then either confirm safe or fix to use dynamic allocation with key-size-based sizing.
